scene: The tuned beam illuminates three unusual exits along the high catwalk platform.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view of the catwalk platform. On the far left sits an open service elevator glowing with buttons. The curly-haired boy in a denim jacket and glasses stands left of centre with his camera. At centre, a wooden rowing boat floats in an elevated canal. On the far right, a sturdy freight lift waits open.
shown: an open metal service elevator with glowing call buttons on the far left
a tethered wooden rowing boat floating in an elevated water flume at centre
a heavy iron freight lift with grated sliding gates on the far right
